correctness.rationale: The derivation identity and \(\operatorname{rank}N=n-1\ge2\) force \(D(V)\subseteq V\) and \([B,N]=aN\). Cyclicity gives \(B=aH+p(N)\). The idempotency equation \(D^2=D\) forces \(a\in\{0,1\}\); when \(a=0\), the local algebra \(k[N]\) has only the two idempotents \(0,I\). When \(a=1\), three consecutive diagonal entries rule out odd characteristic; in characteristic two the recurrence \(b_{2j}=b_j^2\) gives all solutions, with odd-indexed coefficients free. Multiplying their number by the relevant kernel dimension yields the exact rank enumerator. The independent verifier constructs the full derivation linear space and agrees for all seven finite-field tests; finite tests are not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The assessed claim enumerates idempotent derivations by rank over all finite fields for a standard filiform family, and identifies a characteristic-two failure of the complex-field abelian-image conclusion. Avetisyan already determines the ambient derivation space, but the nonlinear projection equations, finite-field multiplicities, parity split, and nonabelian-image obstruction are not asserted there. Bai–Gao–Li assumes characteristic zero, and the published almost-inner and adjoint-rank studies address different operators. Strongest residual risk is an unidentified more general gradings or derivation-counting result.

value.rationale: This naturally motivated exact census refines an existing structural Lie derivation classification by a complete nontrivial rank distribution in every dimension and field order. The positive-characteristic correction is structural: idempotent derivations may have nonabelian image, unlike the complex-field theorem. The odd/even dimension parity controls the extra rank strata, with explicit multiplicities rather than mere existence. It is not presented as a classification of arbitrary filiform algebras.
